title: Figasmo
body:
An addon that integrates **PlasmoVoice** into **Figura**, adding new features and functionality.

New globals:
- `plasmovoice:getVoiceLevel(UUID)` — to get the player speech level.
UUID — Player UUID, e.g., `player:getUUID()`.
- `plasmovoice:getVersion()` — to get the version of mod.

New event:
- `FIGASMO.PLASMOVOICE_PLAYER_SPEAK(activationId, distance)`
activationId — to get an activation by its unique identifier.
distance — to get the activation distance.
```
FIGASMO = FIGASMO or {}

function FIGASMO.PLASMOVOICE_PLAYER_SPEAK(activationId, distance)
    -- YOUR CODE
end
```
